TITLE: Diffusion Gradient Editor
BIHARMONIC_NOTE: A stiff sheet held along the curves: smooth everywhere, as in Finch et al.'s freeform vector graphics.
HARMONIC_NOTE: A stretched membrane held along the curves: never overshoots, as in Orzan et al.'s diffusion curves.
SHEET_NOTE: One component as a height over the box. The harmonic model is a membrane, stretched between the curves that hold it: it's creased along them and peaked at their ends. The biharmonic model is a stiff sheet that bends smoothly through them, and past a jump it keeps going, above 1 or below 0. Drag to turn it.
